_comment: RCS edit. Surfaces as a NEW content://mms row (mms:17) with the edited body; the original (mms:16) is retained unchanged. The edit row INHERITS the original's date/date_sent (1779669371000) - that inherited timestamp + same thread + same sender is the only signal to correlate it to the original. classifier rule: new provider_id whose (thread_id+sender+event_ts) match a prior row, with a different body_hash => edited.

expected.correlation: matched to the prior message by thread_external_id + sender + sent_at_ms; processor updates that message body rather than creating a new one
